title: Switches and Checks
objective: Define a function with a switch, and print its result with and without the switch.
hint: Define Format-Label with a param block: [string]$Text and [switch]$Upper. Inside, if ($Upper) returns $Text.ToUpper(), and else returns $Text. Then two lines: Write-Output (Format-Label -Text "ready") and Write-Output (Format-Label -Text "ready" -Upper).
